title: Requirements and trust-boundary matrix for the research prototype
author: Faye Niu
purpose: Separate each approved actor, data and action boundary from the implemented mechanism, outstanding authorised work, explicit stop/non-goal and exact local evidence state.

status.interpretation: Implemented or in-place status applies only to named repository mechanisms and selected local, fake-provider or synthetic checks. It does not establish live company-research completion, source truth, legal authority, security effectiveness, human benefit or empirical performance.

limitations: The exhibit contains no empirical value, participant observation, coverage result, cost, timing, source-quality score or production claim.

Local tests establish only the exercised contracts; they do not establish ethics approval, data authority, source lawfulness, live availability, model quality, security effectiveness or external validity.
Offline Companies House syntax and intake do not prove current legal identity or registry truth.
The existence of bounded research code and fake/local checks does not establish completed or authorised live web-search integration.
store=False is not represented as zero data retention and does not replace processing authority or minimisation.
A configured local reviewer is an accountable prototype actor, not a production authenticated principal or evidence of an authorised participant study.
